(The words should be treated as meaningful words and should not be related to each other on the basis of number of letters/consonants/vowels in the word.)

questions.solution:
The logic followed here is : Condition that disrupts or impairs specific function

**Given:**

 
• Stammer : Conversation 

⇒ Stammer can hinder or disrupt conversation.

So,

 
• Option - (1) : Astigmatism : Vision 

​⇒ Astigmatism can hinder or impair vision.

 
• Option - (2) : To make noise : To hear 

​⇒ To make noise does not disrupts hearing 

 
• Option - (3) : Fragrance : Scent 

​⇒ Fragrance is synonym of scent.

 
• Option - (4) : Novocaine : Touch 

​⇒ Novocaine is a substance that affects the ability to feel touch.

Hence, "Option - (1)" is the correct answer

Checking all the options:
